title: Workspace コンテナのイメージ更新 (drift 検出 + ワンクリック再生成)

planning_decisions.decision: drift 判定は incus 専用 capability interface (ImageDriftChecker) で実装
planning_decisions.rationale: host runtime にイメージ概念は無い。DESIGN_PRINCIPLES p2/p6: 共有 Runtime interface を膨らませず、optional interface を store が type-assert する (tab の HeadChangedHook と同パターン)

planning_decisions.decision: stale = container の volatile.base_image != 現行 palmux-ws alias の fingerprint。alias 不在/host では stale=false
planning_decisions.rationale: AC-S7364e3-1-1/1-4。fingerprint 取得は incus image info palmux-ws / incus config get <inst> volatile.base_image を r.run 経由で (incus.go の containerIP と同パターン)

planning_decisions.decision: drift 検出は既存 10s scanPorts ループ (sync_worktree.go) に相乗り
planning_decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES p6 既存資産活用。EventBranchPortsDetected と同じループで EventBranchRuntimeDrift を変化時のみ publish

planning_decisions.decision: 再生成は RestartBranchRuntime のトランザクショナル機構を流用した RegenerateBranchContainer (同 kind incus→incus を強制 Stop→Start、失敗時ロールバック)
planning_decisions.rationale: AC-S7364e3-1-2。RestartBranchRuntime は oldKind==newKind で no-op early-return するため、再生成専用の sibling method で force する。bind-mount は再 add され claude は --resume 復帰

planning_decisions.decision: 自動再生成はしない。更新は明示 POST のみ
planning_decisions.rationale: AC-S7364e3-1-3 / VISION priority_rule 4 lazy spawn・走行中 claude/tmux を勝手に落とさない

planning_decisions.decision: palmux-ws alias 文字列を共有定数化 (現状 incus.go 内 3 箇所ハードコード)
planning_decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES p7 明示的・マジック文字列回避。drift 判定でも参照するため

planning_decisions.decision: UI: header runtime chip + drawer badge に stale バッジ、更新確認モーダルは runtime-change-confirm.tsx を流用、進行 starting→ready 表示、失敗ロールバック表示

gui_spec.state_diagram: stopped/fresh → (scan detects drift) → stale[badge] → (click chip→update action) → confirm-modal → (confirm) → updating[chip=starting] → ready[badge cleared] | error[badge kept, inline error]

implementation_decisions.decision: fix(main): incusBridgeListenAddr returns "" when --addr host is wildcard (0.0.0.0/::)
implementation_decisions.rationale: the bridge listener on <gateway>:port collides with a wildcard main bind (0.0.0.0 already covers the bridge IP) → "address already in use". Surfaced when starting the dev instance for S7364e3-2 UI tests. Production (--addr 127.0.0.1) unaffected.

implementation_decisions.decision: UI: update badge on header chip (data-update-available + workspace-update-badge) + drawer entry, update-container-confirm modal, regenerateContainer store action, branch.runtimeDrift event handler
implementation_decisions.rationale: AC-S7364e3-2-1..2-4; reused runtime-change-confirm.tsx pattern + existing chip menu

review_decisions.finding: RuntimeViewFor surfaced Stale from a leaked cache entry even for host runtimes
review_decisions.fix: guard Stale to rt.Kind()==incus-container + clearDriftCached on CloseBranch and on host↔incus switch (RestartBranchRuntime)

review_decisions.finding: Stop cleared exposed (unpublishAll) but not activeMappings/lastPorts → after Regenerate the fresh container never re-ran ExposePort, leaving localhost-only dev servers unreachable
review_decisions.fix: Stop now resets activeMappings + lastPorts (container is gone, all port-rescue state invalid)

review_decisions.finding: aliasFingerprint len==1 fallback could return an unrelated image fingerprint (incus image list does substring matching)
review_decisions.fix: removed fallback — only an EXACT alias-name match returns a fingerprint, else "" (no update target → not stale)

review_decisions.finding: concurrent Regenerate for the same workspace would race on the shared probe instance name
review_decisions.fix: per-branch regenInflight guard in RegenerateBranchContainer rejects a second concurrent update

review_decisions.finding: incus image list -f json returns FULL 64-char fingerprint (matches volatile.base_image)
review_decisions.fix: verified on deploy VM (both 64 chars) + real-mode test detects correctly — REFUTED as a bug

deferred_to_backlog.item: After container regenerate, the in-container Browser tab (S62374c) Manager keeps state=running with a stale cdpAddr/PID; user must Stop+Start the browser. Reset the browser Manager on branch.restarted.
deferred_to_backlog.why: cross-feature edge (browser is S62374c); regenerate itself is correct; Start self-heals via isPIDAlive

deferred_to_backlog.item: Drift check runs 2 incus CLI calls per incus workspace every 10s; the identical palmux-ws alias query is repeated per-workspace. Hoist alias fingerprint to once-per-scan or cache with TTL.
deferred_to_backlog.why: efficiency only; single-user / few-workspace scale (VISION) makes 2N/10s acceptable for now

deferred_documented.item: Regenerate is transactional against the realistic failure (probe-launch verifies the image before destroying old). The residual window — Start fails immediately after a successful probe + old-container delete — leaves the workspace container-less; a retry POST recreates it (Start re-inits the absent container). Documented trade-off vs a temp-instance rename (rejected for Caddy/port-state complexity).
deferred_documented.why: probe catches image-missing/broken/host-misconfig; post-probe Start failure is rare and retry-recoverable

deferred_documented.item: Regenerate drops the user-published-port (exposed subdomain) state with the old container; the 10s scan loop re-emits EventBranchPortsChanged so the Ports tab refreshes within a cycle. User re-exposes ports on the fresh container if desired.
deferred_documented.why: fresh container = fresh port state; self-heals within one scan cycle

real_mode_ui_validation.method: local real-browser Playwright → SSO login → open workspace → stale fixture via re-alias palmux-ws to older fingerprint
real_mode_ui_validation.result: PASS — header chip + drawer show ⬆update badge; chip→Update container→confirm(mentions --resume)→regenerate→badge CLEARED, chip ready. Screenshot evidence /tmp/s7364e3_badge.png
real_mode_ui_validation.note: playwright-python cannot run on the Nix deploy VM; the e2e file runs on an incus+playwright host. Real-mode validated manually via remote browser (same pattern as noVNC AC-2-11). Backend acceptance test (urllib+incus) ran ON the VM and ALL PASS.
